correctness.rationale: Step 1 gives uniform collapse to a simply connected 2-complex, proving only H2 can survive and torsion-free integrally. Step 2 obtains exact reduced equivariant Euler class from the star/top clique cover and oriented edges. Step 3 derives all cycle-type traces from fixed flags and fixed oriented edges. Step 4 uses the four-by-four Jacobi–Trudi determinant and telescoping sums in symmetric functions to obtain each distinct S^(n-j-2,j,1,1) once. For all 130 conjugacy-class instances n<=9,k central, direct signed Lefschetz faces, cycle count, and Murnaghan–Nakayama agree, plus 4 exhaustive mod-2 boundary homology checks. Verified standalone code and recorded output included; finite checks are corroboration, not proof of infinity.

value.rationale: Symmetric-group symmetry is intrinsic to Johnson graphs and their hypersimplex geometry. An all-parameter multiplicity-free decomposition into explicit four-row Specht modules classifies the actual H2 module beyond the known sphere count, yields every group element trace and proves no global invariant class. This structural representation is not the familiar two-row module on vertex functions; it is a motivated invariant rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
